description:
A student asked for a new verification link (POST /auth/resend-verification).
Notifications sends the same email as for ``UserRegistered``; older links have already
stopped working.

Not published for unknown or already-verified emails. Published on the
``events.accounts`` stream. Consumers: Notifications.

email.description: Where to send the verification email.
email.title: Email

firstName.description: For the greeting in the email.
firstName.title: Firstname

verificationToken.description: Goes into the verification link. Valid for 24 hours; a later resend replaces it.
verificationToken.title: Verificationtoken
